text:
maria: git-leak-scan flagged a GCP refresh_token leaked in GHA runner stdout for repo infra/terraform. run id 2026-04-12_03:14. looks like tests call `gcloud auth print-access-token` and stdout got captured in archived build logs. not sure how long this has been exposed. @ops-oncall can you start containment?

sec-bot: [AUTO] leak detection: gcp_refresh_token pattern match in artifacts/artifact-2026-04-12-0314.log (severity: medium). link: https://internal/sec/alerts/1763001234

jamal: on it. immediate plan: revoke/rotate, search all repos & history, scrub logs, fix CI to mask stdout. will post commands.

alex: do we know if this token came from a service account key or oauth refresh for a human/runner? that changes rotation steps.

maria: appears to be from the runner invoking `gcloud auth login --brief` in a test helper (bad test fixture). not a full sa json, but the service account used by the runner may have broad roles.

ops-oncall: starting rotation now. revoking token and creating new SA key. updating vault path secret/infra/ci/gcp-token. will also rotate any long-lived keys I find.

jamal: scanning repo history and org-wide logs. useful commands:

```
# search for literal token snippet in git history
git log --all -S 'ya29.' --pretty=format:'%H %an %ad' --name-only

# run gitleaks across all repos (run from monorepo index)
gitleaks detect --source . --config .gitleaks.toml --report gitleaks-report.json

# quick grep in build archives
zgrep -E "(ya29\.|refresh_token)" /mnt/build-archives/*.log || true
```

jamal: initial results: two historical run logs in infra/terraform/archive/ that contain the token, and one ephemeral log in .github/workflows/test.yml run output. will coordinate scrub/deletion.

alex: quick KMS/RBAC check: restrict iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator to the minimal CI SA and deny project-wide SA key create via org policy. also enable CMEK for any secrets stored that way.

infra-team: noted. we'll prepare an org-policy PR to deny serviceAccountKeyCreation for non-admins and add a constraint to limit who can impersonate SAs.

ops-oncall: rotation done — created new key id: key-01b2c3, revoked old token via GCP console, updated Vault path. pushing new secret to CI (masked). changed secret TTL to 1h for runner short-lived creds.

maria: thanks. jamal — what's the scrub plan (force-push or archive purge)? need to avoid breaking forks.

jamal: plan: 1) remove leaked binary logs from artifact storage (delete archived files) 2) for git history we have two options: BFG + force-push or leave history and rotate keys + mark PSAs. given low scope I'm proposing to remove only the files that are just build logs (not source commits) and add rewrite for anything committed. will propose exact commits and coordinate a force-push window.

alex: also add masking to GH Actions: set `ACTIONS_STEP_DEBUG: false`, and wrap `gcloud` calls like:
```
- name: auth
  run: |
    token=$(gcloud auth print-access-token)
    echo "::add-mask::$token"
```
but ideally avoid printing tokens entirely.

ops-oncall: updated runbook: https://internal/runbooks/gcp-ci-leak - containment steps, rotation checklist, and how to scrub artifacts.

maria: creating INC-2026-83, assigning to @jamal and @ops-oncall. postmortem due EOD Friday, include root cause, timeline, and remediation verification steps.

jamal: kicked off full gitleaks + git-secrets sweep across top 100 repos. tagging hits to this incident. also enabling pre-commit gitleaks for infra/ repos.

infra-team: we'll add least-privilege bindings for the CI SA, audit KMS key access logs, and limit who can create SA keys. also adding logging retention policy so we keep audit logs for 1yr.

maria: short-term todo (assigned):
- ops-oncall: confirm all old tokens revoked and Vault rotated (done)
- jamal: scrub builds and submit force-push plan if needed
- infra-team: org-policy PR to block SA key create for non-admins
- alex: add GH masking/snippets to CI templates and update runner image
- sec: prepare notification for affected internal teams and legal if needed

sec-bot: [AUTO] Incident INC-2026-83 created and assigned.

maria: thanks everyone. please update the incident ticket as you complete tasks. tagging follow-up meeting tomorrow 09:30 to review postmortem. :lock:
